B1-1.name: Fighting For {{Possessive}} Boss (Earth Discharge)
B1-1.description: {{nickname}} unleashes {{possessive}} hammer of rock and pounds around, dealing [Earth] damage and [Knockback].

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Smash in front, dealing AoE empowered damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Swing hammer in an arc in front, dealing AoE damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Smash around three times, forming large craters, dealing AoE empowered damage equal to % of attack. Opponents touching craters get the debuff [Dazed].

additional.text: {{effect:dazed}}
{{effect:knockback}}

B1-2.name: Lightning Rondo (Electricity Discharge)
B1-2.description: {{nickname}} coats {{possessive}} body in lightning and charges forward, dealing [Fire] damage and applying [Electrocute] per hit.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Shoot small bolts ahead, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Throw a condensed whip of lightning, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Charged Basic Skill: Costing -5% of energy gauge, charge up an ultra-sized ball of lightning, taking 3 seconds, increasing movement speed by +150% during its charge. When charged, it will be tossed forward, dealing AoE ranged damage equal to % of attack. This stage will be skipped if the energy gauge is empty.

additional.text: Can activate Stage 3 by holding Basic Skill.
{{effect:electrocute}}
{{effect:freeze}}

B1-3.name: Tornado Engulfment (Wind Discharge)
B1-3.description: {{nickname}} conjures wind around {{object}} that bends to {{possessive}} will, dealing [Wind] damage.

stages.name: Stage 1
stages.text: Wields a wind blade and swipes quickly, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 2
stages.text: Send a gust of wind that bewilders opponents, dealing damage equal to % of attack.

stages.name: Stage 3
stages.text: Costing -3% of energy gauge, summons a mini-tornado in front, dealing % of attack as damage. The tornado will linger for 5 seconds and absorb the next attack (from self or ally) and buff its damage by +20% ([Fire] getting +40% instead). This stage will be skipped if the energy gauge is empty.

additional.text: Every stage hit will heal self and allies for 30% of the damage dealt.

S1-1.name: Mound Defense
S1-1.description: {{nickname}} becomes fired up (only temporarily as {{subject}} is lazy often, but chooses to act for {{possessive}} boss). {{Subject}} grants a [Shield] to allies and self equal to % of max health if any ally has their health at or below 30%.

additional.text: {{effect:shield}}
Cooldown: 16 seconds
Mana Cost: 170 MP

S1-2.name: Mana Zone - Eletrostep Overdrive
S1-2.description: Gathering the surrounding mana, {{nickname}} will gain an enhanced electricity state that will increase {{possessive}} Basic Skill damage by % for 15 seconds. {{Possessive}} steps become a blur of lightning, increasing movement speed by an additional +1% for each extra point of movement speed above 100.

additional.text: In the state, {{possessive}} interruption resistance will increase and {{subject}} can pass through opponents, inflicting [Electrocute].
{{effect:electrocute}}
{{effect:freeze}}
Cooldown: 18 seconds
Mana Cost: 230 MP

S1-3.name: Towering Tornado
S1-3.description: Summon a larger swirling tornado for 5 seconds that gathers opponents together, a range of 20 meters, and flattens them, dealing % of attack as [Wind] damage.

additional.text: Each opponent gathered will struggle, unable to escape easily for the tornado’s duration, and heal self and allies for % of max health for each opponent gathered.
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Mana Cost: 155 MP

S2.name: Prepare to Fight!
S2.description: Gather elemental power together and create a ring around self with the respective active subordinate’s element, absorbing % of incoming damage, an additional +10% for projectiles, for 10 seconds.

additional.text: Active character will continuously gain the effect [Hyped] while elemental ring is active.
[Hyped] Buff: Basic Skill will only perform Stage 3 when attacking, skipping prior stages, lasting 5 seconds.
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Mana Cost: 90 MP

U1.name: A Kick, a Punch, and… Serious
U1.description: If the character’s health is above 40%, perform the skill as titled, otherwise, when below, transform to Ultimate Skill: Mountain Truck Rampage.

additional.text: <u>Ultimate Skill: A Kick, a Punch, and…</u> - The current subordinate proves their worth to their boss with exclusive talent. Throw a series of fast close-quarters punches via the Basic Skill, imbued with the damage and element of the subordinate’s Stage 3. The state lasts for 15 seconds and will add a rage to the tri-node rage meter per hit, dispersing a shockwave and resistance shred at its prescribed intervals.

Ultimate Skill: Mountain Truck Rampage - The other two subordinates arrive on the scene and the trio will hop into the newly summoned vehicle, a truck. The vehicle can be controlled and will deal active member’s elemental damage equal to % of attack when ramming any number of enemies. The vehicle gains +20% of speed stat and lasts for 13 seconds.

During the duration, gain 15 combat rage points and other subordinates will perform their Stage 3 Basic Skill attacks per stack, depleting a stack per attack. If {{nickname:c7}} is an ally, {{subject:c7}} will also join the ride and attack with {{possessive:c7}} Stage 3 Basic Skill, consuming a stack. All who can attack will attack every 2 seconds.
For self and {{nickname:c7}}, heal +% of health per second on the ride’s duration.
Energy Gauge: 130% (Requires overflow energy as indicated by a secondary gauge on the Ultimate Skill button)

T1.name: Attack Unison - All for One!
T1.description: When stamina is reduced to less than 5%, rotate to the next subordinate in the order: {{nickname:c11:0}}, {{nickname:c11:2}}, {{nickname:c11:1}} (Cooldown: 20 seconds). Restore 30% stamina upon switching.

additional.text: When switching, the next character will come in and deal 350% of attack as their respective elemental damage and apply a -15% resistance reduction to that element to hit opponents for 25 seconds.

A special tri-node rage meter will record the instance of each rotation. At three points, a shockwave will hit nearby opponents for the same damage and an additional elemental resistance reduction of -25% will be applied to those that have one for a new duration of 40 seconds (costs -15% of energy gauge to apply).
The damage each subordinate deals upon entry and the damage of the shockwave is further amplified by +10% per level of the highest Special Skill equipped.
Resonance: No additional effects.

Dupes.description: {{nickname:c11:0}} will receive a defense bonus of +30%, {{nickname:c11:2}} gains +50% piercing, and {{nickname:c11:1}} receives +20% attack speed and movement speed. The subordinates’ energy gauge accumulation is -20% less effective as other characters but they can gain a max of 200% of energy instead of 100%.

additional.text: A main individual can be chosen out of the trio to be the first summoned when in a party selection.

Obtain a combat rage meter that stores the number of successive Basic Skill stage hits (max 25), deteriorating one stack per 2 seconds when reaching 10 stacks. While rage meter is active, it will cause the other two subordinates not active to attack with their respective Stage 1 Basic Skills randomly every 3 seconds. This can occur even when the active subordinate is off-field.
When the other subordinates attack from the cumulative rage meter, inflict the [Debuff Contagion] effect on opponents. Increases energy gauge gain by +2% for every stack in the rage meter.
[Debuff Contagion] Debuff: Opponents’ resistance to debuffs are decreased by -50% for 9 seconds.
Increases the damage of Special Skills by +15%.

Status effects that deal damage over time, like [Burn] or [Poison], will deal more damage to enemies with resistance reduction of any element, the damage scaling increases as a percentage equal to the highest percentage of resistance reduction on the opponent. Such applied debuff effects will have a duration increase of +30%.

The combat rage meter can accumulate stacks while the subordinates are off-field when the current active character attacks with Basic Skill hits. All three subordinates will then attack with Stage 2 Basic Skill attacks randomly every 3 seconds. The damage will increase by +30% when the subordinates are off-field for more than 5 seconds and effect will end when they come back on-field.
